context.label: Snapshot-bound context, local rewrite suggestions, and read-only proposal receipts

body.title: Capture saved scene context
body.description: Reads the selected scene and its explicitly linked saved manuscript at the Host snapshot. Drafts are excluded here.

body.title: Suggest from an exact selection
body.description: Supply the scene ID, saved manuscript revision, UTF-16 offsets, and exact selected text. The Host checks the selection before returning local candidates.

body.title: Local source-grounded candidates
body.description: Choose a candidate to submit one exact-range ChangeSet proposal to Host review.

body.title: Workspace and local settings
body.description: Model aliases are preferences; provider access and consent remain Host controlled.

body.title: Propose workspace compute budget
body.description: Review a shared nonsecret default. This does not enable a provider or grant access.

body.title: Preview synonym prompt
body.description: Preview the prompt locally before requesting suggestions.

body.title: Preview setting question
body.description: Review the exact conversation and saved scene context locally. This does not send a provider request.

body.title: Optional provider availability
body.description: Provider requests need a separate confirmation of their exact payload. Local tools remain available without a provider.
